messages:
ashley: Quick idea — offseason sweepstakes + office BBQ bet? Everyone picks 3 free agents they think will sign by June 1, and 2 breakout rookies. Winner gets the BBQ crown (and the loser brings sides). :meat_on_bone: :crown:

mike: I'm in. $20 buy-in to the snack fund? :moneybag:

ashley: Yep $20 or bring a full 6-pack of chips. Loser cooks or chips = snack fund. :+1:

chris: I'll make a sheet and auto-score. Who wants the scoring rules? Options:
- 2 points per correct free agent signing
- 3 points per breakout rookie (defined as >400 rushing/receiving yards or >30 tackles)
- 1 bonus point for correctly guessing a surprise big contract

raul: Surprise big contract? I'm just here to bet against mike. :grin:

ashley: Love it. Add a tiebreaker: total combined guaranteed money predicted for biggest FA (round to nearest million).

mike: Fine. Also, can we add a victory lap GIF to the pot? Loser has to post one every Friday for a month. :laughing:

ashley: Deal. GIF standard: must be work-safe and not >5MB. :ok_hand:

chris: Sheet posted: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1OFFSEASON_SWEEPSTAKES (I'll DM invites)

ashley: Quick poll — picks locked on May 1. Is that OK?

mike: Works for me. Gives me time to emotionally prepare.

raul: May 1 works. Also can we let people submit a late wild-card for -1 point? (jk)

ashley: No wildcard cheating allowed. :detective:

chris: Devops bot can create the calendar event and remind people. @devops-bot can you schedule a reminder for May 1 9:00 AM PT to close entries and run scoring?

devops-bot: Scheduled: "Offseason sweepstakes — entries close" on 2026-05-01 09:00 PT. Reminder will ping #random and the participants.

tina: Two quick rules suggestions: (1) If a player signs and is cut before June 1, still counts. (2) If a rookie is on PUP and doesn't play at all, no breakout points.

ashley: Both sounds fair. I'll add to the sheet.

chris: For automation I'm adding a tiny randomizer to assign draft order in case we want a snake draft for additional side bets. Code I used:
```python
import random
players = ['ashley','mike','tina','chris','raul']
order = random.sample(players, len(players))
print(order)
```

raul: That settles it — if I get first pick I'm drafting chaos.

mike: @ashley do we allow late signings after June 1 if they're due to being unsigned until then? Eg. someone signs Jun 2 because of paperwork — zero points?

ashley: Lock date is cutoff. June 1 means official signing date must be <= 2026-06-01. No exceptions.

tina: Can someone make a small graphic for the BBQ trophy? I'll print it for the winner. :art:

chris: I'll mock up a quick pixel crown and post it later tonight.

ashley: OK final checklist: sheet link in #random (done), $20 buy-in or equivalent (collect in person or Venmo @ashley), picks locked May 1, scoring rules added. Anyone else?

mike: I'm Venmoing you now. Good luck, all. I'll win and never shut up about it. :triumph:

raul: Rage-twitter-style jubilation incoming.

ashley: Thread closed unless someone objects. See y'all at the BBQ pot. :tada:"
